newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures wander moderately higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures wander moderately higher.

text.p: June 10 - U.S. stock index futures wandered moderately higher in early afternoon. Traders said June S&P 500s technically could have slight downside bias this afternoon after failing to return above the 868.00 level. Some chartist looked for retest of 865.00 and possibly 863.00 area. A rise back above 870.00, however, could portend a new all-time, they said.
